results.title: Outcome gate rejects changed failure signatures and unexpected passes
All production classic/module JavaScript parses in its actual mode
Local imports and script/stylesheet references resolve except the tracked Tasks model
Google Tasks model import must resolve
All other inline and external CSS parses
Dashboard style block must have valid CSS syntax
Date normalization accepts compact dates and leap day, rejects invalid day
Stage end counts working days and shifts holiday deadlines
Legacy absolute stage dates become stable relative offsets
Unchanged completed stage retains its dates and completion history
Checklist completion requires explicit history-preserving reopen before unchecking
Dependent stage dates must use the preserved completed stage anchor
Adding a new checklist item must not silently reopen completed history
Deleting a completed stage is rejected and retains the original task history
Negative stage offsets must be timezone independent (UTC+14)
Schema11 roundtrip preserves tasks, history, templates, rules, projects and settings
Removed recurrence retains its stored generation lock
Project and template attachments exclude inline data and transient URLs
Local-only holiday setting is excluded from cloud records
Backup merges disjoint IDs and identical records without duplication or mutation
Backup conflict must not silently overwrite completed history
Object-form template checklist must retain text instead of string coercion
Task projectResources must exclude inline bytes and transient URLs too
Month end clamps correctly across short months and leap years
Monthly generation has stable dates, fresh checklist IDs and is idempotent
Canonical semiannual schedule generates every six months
Recurrence end is inclusive and completed roots remain unchanged
Supported selectedMonths filters dates and holiday shifts preserve weekends
Schema11 cycleMonths must filter actual generated occurrences
Legacy half cycle must generate the semiannual occurrence
Generated recurrence must carry a durable deduplication key
Desktop quick-task validates blank name and registers one synthetic task
Mobile quick-task opens, accepts input and cancels without mutation
HTML cannot read app localStorage
SVG script cannot read app localStorage
XHTML downloads
XML downloads despite text MIME
PDF extension cannot disguise HTML response
Image extension cannot disguise SVG response
Forged image MIME with HTML bytes downloads
Recognized MIME must match extension
Normal PNG still renders
Normal PDF still opens
Ordinary binary downloads unchanged
Explicit active-file download preserves bytes
Blocked popup falls back to download
Legacy missing declared MIME still previews a verified image
Hydrated HTML cache cannot supply an active document
Newly uploaded SVG cache cannot supply an active document
MOCK Google login, Drive profile, private auth and Firestore binding remain usable
MOCK reload restores the private SDK session without password or Drive prompt
MOCK expired private session falls back to existing Drive credentials
Cache stores an allowlist without password, OAuth token or arbitrary profile fields
Legacy full-profile cache is sanitized on module load
MOCK logout clears caches and private SDK sessions; relogin still works
MOCK Google account switch separates cache, tokens and private auth
Profiles with wrong or missing Google owner are rejected before private login
Malformed profile types are rejected
Drive token expires in memory and session storage
Missing identity and malformed expiry cannot restore Drive tokens
Drive/Tasks tokens stay separate from password-free persistent profile
MOCK Drive reauthentication rejects a different Google identity
Logout clears app cache even when SDK signout fails
Profile error logs omit arbitrary error payloads
Legacy Drive token expires even if still held in memory
Legacy Drive token cannot cross Google accounts
Cloud adapter does not persist a second copy of the current Drive token
MOCK delayed SDK auth restoration is awaited before password fallback
MOCK auth observer clears old credentials on external account change
Cloud cleanup event clears legacy token, profile references and listeners
Blocked browser storage does not prevent authenticated workspace connection
Completed checklist text, date, participants and attachment refs survive stage edits
Whole project edits preserve the completed task and stage without input mutation
Completed checklist cannot reopen a task implicitly
Explicit reopen appends a detached snapshot once, preserving IDs and attachments
Reopened all-checked tasks do not auto-complete during an ordinary project save
Active checklist completion works and a second explicit reopen records a separate cycle
Project deletion is blocked before mutation when any completion record exists
Reopened stage history cannot be deleted by a later project edit
Repeated completed project edits do not create duplicate history or change IDs
Optional completion snapshots roundtrip through unchanged schema11 serialization
Oversized history is rejected before reopening instead of losing the completed record
Pending stage removal and automatic completion remain available
New rolling occurrences do not inherit the source task completion history
Project completion modal locks checks; explicit reopen stores history and rolls back failed save
General status/save guards protect completed records; new clones do not copy history
General completed-task edit uses a read-only view and explicit reopen retains prior record
